grader.independence_basis: Independent logical grader configuration; fresh ephemeral read-only process per frozen grader packet in an empty Git repository, no primary role, candidate implementation or dataset curation participation. The provider exposes no immutable backend snapshot.

adjudicator.independence_basis: Independent logical adjudicator configuration; fresh ephemeral read-only process receives only the original frozen prompt for a necessary disagreement and sees no primary response or grade before its answer is sealed. No candidate implementation or dataset curation participation. The provider exposes no immutable backend snapshot.
